🏛️📅 No More Friday Holiday as Government Ends Austerity Measures

The government has officially discontinued the Friday holiday policy, restoring the regular workweek schedule across public offices as part of its decision to end previously introduced austerity measures.

💼 The Friday closure was initially implemented to reduce energy consumption and cut government expenditures during a period of economic challenges.

⚡ With the latest policy revision, government departments and offices will now operate under their normal working schedule, aiming to improve administrative efficiency and public service delivery.

📈 Officials say the decision reflects changing economic conditions and the need to ensure uninterrupted government operations.

📅 Employees and citizens are advised to check updated office timings and schedules issued by their respective departments.

🗣️ The move has sparked mixed reactions, with some welcoming the return to normal operations while others believe the holiday helped save energy and resources.
